goals: Maintain the private Foundation resource pack for Minecraft Java 26.2 without modifying its immutable source archive.
scope: Maintain the consolidated Foundation and Matcha Overlays resources, including the v7 leaf inventory previews.

Restore vanilla 26.2 Netherrack, Nether Bricks and End Stone Bricks above Matcha Flavoured and supply Matcha Red Sandstone artwork for AMC's Button, Pressure Plate, Parapet, Gothic Window, Arrow Slit and Louvered Shutter.
Recolor all five native BBB and four native Macaw's Windows Red Sandstone forms in Foundation, retaining provider geometry, state selection and decorative artwork.

exclusions: originals/resourcepacks/Foundation v4.zip and originals/resourcepacks/Matcha-Overlays-v37.zip are immutable and are neither changed nor redistributed.
Block Geometry Extensions, BGE x Bushy Leaves, Mynx Trees Java code, Enderscape Integration Java code, Enderscape Overlays, and unrelated projects are outside this resource-pack consolidation.
No Minecraft test profile is inspected or changed.

dependencies.reason: Supplies the complete v8 pack, including the six AMC forms, vanilla material restorations and merged CTMs.
Supplies the Red Sandstone artwork. Matching cut and chiseled sprites establish its seven-shade stone palette at corresponding vanilla pixel coordinates.
Supplies the original block PNGs, model routes, English translations and Red Sandstone bottom fallback for resource pack format 88.

dependencies.reason: Its existing models select the shared sprites and separately baked shutter. The C25 lighting recipe uses the Macaw's Windows 2.4.2 Andesite shutter mask.

dependencies.requirement: Optional native provider. Build reference is BBB Canary 9 (dev.7), SHA-256 57ddb5dfe62f2eb9f4a2ce22fbeeb5cce4386bbd93aab3f7df0dd8e6d19ddaf0.
dependencies.reason: Provides the five registered Red Sandstone masonry forms, model routes and nine baked sheets.

dependencies.requirement: Optional native provider. Build reference is Macaw's Windows 2.4.2 for Fabric 26.2, SHA-256 40ba9c55f191f8bd4758293683ed2bcf6d0c76c8f54f9fc8a0dccabdbcfd36ad.
dependencies.reason: Provides four Red Sandstone window blocks with twenty frame models and one shared glass-only center.

state.milestone: Foundation v9 passed static checks for every native Red Sandstone blockstate and inventory selector from BBB and Macaw's Windows. In-game visual verification is pending.

current.summary: Brings Matcha Red Sandstone to all five native BBB masonry forms and four Macaw's Windows blocks while preserving their carved details and moving parts.
